'''High Inquisitor Whitemane''', a priestess of the Light, leads the activities in the [[Scarlet Monastery]]. The Monastery was once a proud bastion of Lordaeron's priesthood - a center for learning and enlightenment but with the rise of the undead Scourge during the Third War, the peaceful Monastery was converted into a stronghold of the fanatical Scarlet Crusade. Under Whitemane's command, the members of the [[Scarlet Crusade]] present have become ever more extreme in their battle against the [[Scourge]]. 

Their grasp on reality was slipping. As time moved on, Whitemane and her followers no longer trusted anyone that was not part of their own [[Scarlet Crusade]], considering them plagued. Large numbers of innocent men and women were tortured and eventually killed because of this. 


=== Lore Status ===
Whitemane is one of the four leaders of the Scarlet Monastery. It is known that both [[Raleigh the Devout]] in the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]] and [[Varimathras]] in the [[Undercity]] are determined to eliminate the leadership of the Scarlet Monastery, albeit for different reasons.

==Memorable Quotes:==

*"There is no escape for you. The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the scourge's taint."

*"The Light has spoken!"

*"What, Mograine has fallen?  You shall pay for this treachery!"
After you have slain Mograine, Whitemane will join the battle *immediately*. Once you get her to about 30%, she'll shield herself, sleep the entire party, and begin to raise her fallen Champion. If you're in a group of less than 5, remained focused on removing Whitemane from the face of Azeroth. Once she's down, then focus on the raised Mograine and killing him (again).

*"Arise, my champion!"

==World of Warcraft:==

High Inquisitor Whitemane has several items unique to her which you can loot after you kill her. You cannot aquire these items anywhere else in the game.

* '''One Handed Mace:''' [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?witem=7721 Hand of Righteousness]
* '''Cloth Headpiece:''' [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?witem=7720 Whitemane's Chapeau]
* '''Necklace:''' [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?witem=7722 Triune Amulet]

Killing her is also a goal of the following quests:

* '''Horde:''' {{questnotb|horde|42D|Into the Scarlet Monastery}}
* '''Alliance:''' {{questnotb|alliance|40D|In the Name of the Light}}
